patronOf.en-US: The bread offered on the altar
patronOf.pt-BR: O pão oferecido sobre o altar

prayerExcerpt.en-US: The Priest, standing at the altar, takes the paten with the bread and holds it slightly raised above the altar with both hands.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: O sacerdote, de pé junto ao altar, recebe a patena com o pão em suas mãos.

meta.basis: The paten is, with the chalice, the vessel in which 'the bread and wine are offered and consecrated' (GIRM 327), of precious metal (GIRM 328); 'a large paten may fittingly be used' for the hosts of priest, ministers and faithful (GIRM 331); it is prepared on the credence table (GIRM 118c) and raised with the bread at the Preparation of the Gifts (the excerpt's rubric). The card shows a single large host, the traditional priest's paten; the bread is unconsecrated, before the Offertory.
